verdict.rationale: Ollama ships an official CLI (installed via install.sh, invoked as 'ollama run/pull/rm/launch') that is central to its workflow, with commands like 'ollama launch' specifically designed for agentic coding workflows (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) and strong community corroboration of everyday CLI use (pull/rm/run/hotswap). Missing for 10: no dedicated CLI reference doc page cited, and some community friction about CLI defaults/config exposure (ollama-comm-13).
